artifact.identity: Mermaid Theme Builder static browser application

decision_question: Is the frozen 0.6.2 artifact ready for a bounded public v1.0.0 release within its browser-only, privacy-preserving, renderer-aware scope?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Fresh-browser representative full and partial-family journeys paste, detect, theme, preview, copy, and download valid source without stale output.
Extract, profile/share, palette import/export, Prompt Scaffold, Examples, and Reference journeys are discoverable and preserve selected theme/source state.
No backend, login, diagram telemetry, or cloud storage is introduced; documented requests cannot carry diagram or palette data; hostile inputs fail closed.
Automated critical/serious axe scans remain clean and manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, contrast, and customized-state journeys are reviewed.
External renderer claims are either proven with dated evidence or visibly narrowed to guidance with validation caveats.
Required checks run on the exact candidate commit and skipped jobs fail closed; external and manual evidence is dated and scoped.
Public truth surfaces, release assets, debt records, registries, skills, and workflows agree on shipped, planned, observed, and unverified claims.

evidence_sources.finding: Production build passed; Vite emitted non-blocking script and chunk-size warnings.

evidence_sources.source: pnpm test:e2e workflow log for frozen tree
evidence_sources.finding: 243 browser tests passed, including the XY-chart palette assertion.

evidence_sources.source: check:ci-workflow, check:version-strings, check:technology-versions, check:doc-truth, check:skills-catalog, check:source-refs, scripts/check-links.sh

evidence_sources.finding: Twenty axe scans across five tabs, two themes, and desktop/mobile reported no Critical or Serious findings on 2026-09-01.
Renderer guidance exists; Notion, Confluence, M365/Loop, self-hosted GitLab, and several ceilings remain unverified.
Threat boundaries and strict Mermaid controls exist; hostile sink behavior is not directly proven.
Release imagery is not evidence of the frozen 0.6.2 UI until a current capture is reviewed.
Several acceptance and maturity signals remain unchecked or stale despite narrow automated checks.

evidence_sources.source: hostile-input, deep-persistence, PWA-update, manual-accessibility, and external-renderer runs

shared_model_or_source_limits: Evidence, outcome, and safety reviewers used separate delegated contexts but the same frozen repository source set.
The underlying model identity was not available; agreement is correlated and is not independent external corroboration.
No specialist security, accessibility, legal, or renderer-owner review was performed.

initial_reviews.summary: Local implementation and checks support credible v0.6.2 use; privacy egress, renderer parity, extraction round trips, hostile sinks, and complete release gates remain provisional or blocked.
Apply, Examples, Reference, Compose, and Extract are useful within limits; eight-format outcome proof, family-wide consistency, keyboard completion, and product-brief wording remain incomplete.

Strict mode, explicit navigation, and same-origin service-worker boundaries are promising; raw SVG/CSS sinks, malformed persistence, PWA recovery, manual accessibility, renderer portability, and tag operations remain unproven.

concordance.basis: All three initial reviewers independently selected defer-for-evidence for v1.0, with the same high-consequence evidence gaps.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hostile Mermaid or SVG content escapes strict mode into executable preview/export content.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Playwright sentinel and DOM/SVG inspection for scripts, event attributes, dangerous links, foreignObject, and external execution.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Imported CSS/font/color/name/description values break style boundaries or trigger network fetches.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Hostile palette export corpus across CSS, SVG, JSON, init, and frontmatter.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Deeply malformed or oversized share/profile/localStorage state crashes or persists bad data.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Bounded parser and recovery test with malformed nested objects and oversized values.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Normal use sends source content through analytics, fonts, referrers, service-worker requests, or explicit navigation.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Fresh-browser request inventory with secrets in source, query, and hash.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Service worker serves an old shell referencing removed chunks after update/offline launch.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Build-A/build-B offline and worker-update integration test.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, forced-colors, or customized states fail despite axe scans.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Manual accessibility protocol with dated results.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Unverified renderers or long directives silently ignore output.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Renderer/version submission matrix with observed theme, look, and format results.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Malformed tags or failing commits reach a workflow that only checks changelog and screenshot.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Fork dry run and least-privilege workflow contract.

disruptor.disposition: The counterexamples do not overturn defer-for-evidence; several remain material untested boundaries.

decisive_evidence: Hostile export sinks are not proven inert.
Deep persisted-state validation and recovery are absent.
Tag-time release automation does not enforce the complete v1 evidence package.
Manual accessibility and external renderer evidence remain outside the current live proof.
negotiator.bounded_current_use: Approve-with-limits for non-sensitive, user-reviewed diagrams in browser and controlled preview use. Do not call v1 ready, security-validated, or renderer-validated.

claim_ledger.claim: Diagram and palette transformation is browser-side with no backend, login, or cloud storage.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Core privacy and product boundary are false.
claim_ledger.next_test: Fresh source and build audit confirming no server/API surface and browser-only state flow.

claim_ledger.claim: No diagram or palette data leaves the browser during normal use.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Confidential source may leak through an undocumented request.
claim_ledger.next_test: Fresh-context request allowlist across paste, render, edit, extract, import, and export.

claim_ledger.claim: The existing aggregate pageview is privacy-constrained and not content telemetry.
claim_ledger.next_test: Repeat sanitized pageview assertion and prohibit any analytics expansion.

claim_ledger.claim: Family detection and capability labels are accurate for all advertised families.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Users receive incorrect overlays or support expectations.
claim_ledger.next_test: Built-app fixture matrix for 31 families plus unknown input.

claim_ledger.claim: Renderer profiles are reliable compatibility claims.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Exports silently fail in target hosts.
claim_ledger.next_test: Live/holdout renderer submission matrix for representative flowchart and sequence outputs.

claim_ledger.claim: Strict Mermaid mode prevents executable preview content.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Malicious diagrams can execute in the app origin.
claim_ledger.next_test: Hostile preview and rendered-SVG corpus with sentinel assertion.

claim_ledger.claim: Downloaded SVG/CSS/frontmatter artifacts are inert and safe to reopen.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Crafted metadata can create active content or break style boundaries elsewhere.
claim_ledger.next_test: Hostile palette export corpus and structural/external-URL assertions.

claim_ledger.claim: Extract, import, share, and local persistence preserve reusable governance state.
claim_ledger.next_test: Fresh-context round trip including custom names, typography, renderer, format, and advanced settings.

claim_ledger.claim: All eight advertised download formats are outcome-valid.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Users receive malformed or stale deliverables.
claim_ledger.next_test: Download/signature/parse/content checks for all eight formats and two families.

claim_ledger.claim: Prompt Scaffold always reflects the latest source and selected theme.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Generated AI instructions encode stale theme or source.
claim_ledger.next_test: Change source after opening scaffold and assert the regenerated content is current.

claim_ledger.claim: The product meets WCAG 2.1 AA broadly.
claim_ledger.next_test: Manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, contrast, reduced-motion, and customized-state review.

claim_ledger.claim: The PWA is offline-capable and recovers across releases.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Users receive blank or stale apps after updates.

claim_ledger.claim: Release automation enforces the v1 evidence package.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: A tag can be published without safety, build, or test evidence.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exact-SHA tag dry run with fail-closed required checks and least-privilege verification.

claim_ledger.claim: Public documentation accurately describes the current product.
claim_ledger.consequence_if_false: Maintainers and users make decisions from stale maturity signals.
claim_ledger.next_test: Truth-surface reconciliation followed by doc/link/version checks.

release_gates.name: validation health
new_work: Make environment requirements explicit and fail closed on skipped required checks.
release_gates.acceptance: Exact candidate passes unit, typecheck, build, format, docs/source/version/skills/link checks, and E2E with reproducible environment behavior.

release_gates.name: accessibility
new_work: Manual specialist review beyond axe scans.
release_gates.acceptance: Automated scans and manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, contrast, and customized-state journey pass.

release_gates.name: privacy and safety
new_work: Hostile preview/export/import/share/persistence corpus, request allowlist, explicit-navigation, and PWA tests.
release_gates.prerequisite: Gate A; Gate B for error/focus acceptance
release_gates.acceptance: Hostile inputs fail closed, bad state recovers, requests are allowlisted, and service-worker behavior is bounded.

release_gates.name: core journeys
release_gates.acceptance: Extract/history, first-use/share links, export preview/copy/stale state, empty/clipboard states, and remaining journey cases pass in fresh contexts.

release_gates.name: renderer and output evidence
new_work: Holdout/live renderer submissions and all-eight-format outcome checks.
release_gates.acceptance: Representative outputs are proven or explicitly narrowed for each renderer tier; unverified claims remain visible.

release_gates.name: palette and profile integrity
release_gates.acceptance: Names, slots, order, share links, saved formats, syntax hints, and profile state cannot silently change user intent.

release_gates.name: release truth and distribution
new_work: Reconcile stale truth surfaces and enforce exact-SHA tag gates.
release_gates.acceptance: Public docs/assets agree and a release dry run proves failing or skipped checks cannot publish.

owner_only_analytics_proof_task.reason: Analytics is not a valid mitigation for this privacy-first product and must not expand the boundary.

privacy_boundary.existing_aggregate_pageview: Permitted only as the documented constrained exception; it must not contain diagram or palette data and is not a release gate.

mitigations.name: Stabilize validation and fail closed
mitigations.acceptance: Required checks run on exact SHA with PORT/BASE_PATH supplied; skipped checks fail closed; environment failures are reproducible.
mitigations.re_review_trigger: Workflow, runner, Node, pnpm, Playwright, or build configuration change

mitigations.name: Complete accessibility evidence
mitigations.acceptance: Manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, contrast, reduced-motion, and customized-state review passes or is explicitly scoped.
mitigations.re_review_trigger: Interactive control, overlay, layout, theme, or palette-editor change

mitigations.name: Prove hostile input and output boundaries
mitigations.acceptance: Hostile Mermaid, SVG, CSS, font, color, import, share, and persistence fixtures fail closed without execution, leakage, or crash.
mitigations.re_review_trigger: Mermaid, exporter, parser, persistence, share, analytics, font, or service-worker change

mitigations.name: Validate PWA update and offline recovery
mitigations.acceptance: Build-A/build-B worker update and offline scenarios produce a usable current shell or actionable failure.
mitigations.re_review_trigger: Service-worker, manifest, cache, asset, or deployment change

mitigations.name: Prove renderer and eight-format output boundaries
mitigations.acceptance: Live/holdout renderer matrix and all-eight-format payload checks pass or public claims are narrowed.
mitigations.re_review_trigger: Mermaid/renderer version, profile, output format, theme engine, or family overlay change

mitigations.name: Reconcile release truth and exact-SHA distribution
mitigations.acceptance: Truth surfaces, screenshots, debt register, and workflows agree; release dry run blocks failing or skipped checks.
mitigations.re_review_trigger: New release cycle or any public claim, workflow, screenshot, or dependency change

limits: Renderer profiles are guidance, not compatibility guarantees.
Strict Mermaid mode is not a hostile-input certification.
Automated axe results are not universal WCAG certification.
Do not tag or publish v1.0 from this baseline alone.
Keep analytics, telemetry, backend, login, cloud storage, and diagram-content collection out of scope.

limitations: No specialist security, accessibility, legal, or renderer-owner review was performed.
No external renderer holdout or live submission matrix was completed.
No hostile export, deep persistence, PWA update, or manual accessibility run was completed.
Delegated reviewers shared the same source set and unknown underlying model identity.
The review assesses evidence sufficiency, not universal correctness or certification.
review_expiry_triggers: Mermaid, Vite, Node, pnpm, Playwright, or renderer version change
New diagram family, export format, palette schema, profile/share, or persistence behavior
Privacy boundary, analytics transport, fonts, service worker, external navigation, or browser-origin security change
Security, accessibility, legal, or renderer-owner finding
CI, release workflow, tag, deployment, or screenshot automation change
README, product brief, roadmap, changelog, checklist, threat model, or other public-claim change
New release cycle or promotion beyond v0.6.2

follow_up.title: Prove hostile diagram and export inputs cannot create active content
follow_up.scope: Playwright and unit corpus for hostile Mermaid, SVG, CSS, font, color, name, and description values across preview, SVG, CSS, frontmatter, and JSON export sinks.

follow_up.title: Make invalid saved and shared state recover without crashing
follow_up.scope: Deep schema validation, size bounds, reset/recovery behavior, and fresh-context tests for localStorage, theme tokens, and profile tokens.

follow_up.title: Make tagged releases prove the exact candidate passed every required gate
follow_up.scope: Release workflow contract and fork dry runs for semver tags, changelog, build, unit, E2E, documentation, safety corpus, deploy health, and least-privilege permissions.
